description: During the 2026-05-14 morning vision walk, Tier 1 pricing was deferred to 2026-06-25 because Stripe -> PRICING.md/source-of-truth sync is unresolved. Investigate whether Vrooli should leverage the existing Stripe integration inside landing-page-business-suite to pull product/pricing data, or add project-level Stripe integration for pricing synchronization. Compare local/cloud feasibility, ownership boundaries, security/secret handling, and how pricing data would flow into docs/monetization/PRICING.md or its canonical replacement. Output should recommend the integration home and the minimum capability needed to unblock Tier 1 pricing decisions.
name: stripe-pricing-source-of-truth-investigation
title: Investigate Stripe integration path for pricing source-of-truth sync
